# U-001 Import LC issuance workflow

## Flow
Grounded in 04-flows.md §F-U-008 (6-stage maker-checker). At each stage transition the
handler must Update workflow_assignments (current_state, assigned_to_role for next stage)
so the item surfaces in the cross-module Approval Inbox.

## Implementation steps
1. Each controller transition method calls `WorkflowEngine::transition()`, which runs
   `advanceAssignments()` to write the next-stage assignment row.

## Target files
```
app/Http/Controllers/LetterOfCreditController.php
```

## Acceptance
- ✅ Each stage advance creates a workflow_assignments row visible in the inbox
